notes.title: Eagle Flight Version 1.02 Update Released Today!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26621471/afe1d8c304b5c50de7cd6fd1b4f9e26a30effeda.png

Version 1.02 Patch - MMR Compatibility & Controller Maps

Following the launch of Microsoft Mixed Reality headsets, we have taken some time to update the game to better reflect the different controllers our players use. Please feel free to leave comments if you have any feedback regarding these updates. Should you encounter any problems while playing, please be sure to file a ticket with our Customer Support team at support.ubi.com so that we can track the issue and follow up with you!

Please join us in welcoming our new Microsoft MR hatchlings to the skies!

Changes in this patch:
Full support for Microsoft Mixed Reality headsets, including Microsoft Motion Controller support.
Full support for Oculus Touch controllers.
Tutorial and all button icons throughout the game have been updated to fully support all motion controllers. Now, players using any of these controllers will know which buttons they need to use in menus, end of match, etc.
Re-centering support for motion controllers - hold RT + LT together for at least two seconds to re-center the view. (If players are experiencing the "tilt reminder" message often, it could be because we are detecting you looking too far from "center." Re-centering should remedy this.)

notes.title: Title Update: Oculus Compatibility
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26621471/f2bf81f182aba9f803fc104ea43e97a8f1d913b0.png

Hello Eagles!

Just a quick note to let you know that we’ve recently updated Eagle Flight to be compatible with Oculus Rift headsets – all you need to do is launch the game as you would any other Oculus-compatible VR title.

Have fun!
